findings.actual: Flat navy recommendation block meets charcoal detail/footer with abrupt horizontal edges
findings.expected: Use the existing seamless public atmosphere while preserving natural grid height
findings.reproduction: Open published product with related records and scroll across detail-to-related and related-to-footer edges
findings.recommendedFix: Dedicated related-section public-part hook and scoped existing --page-atmosphere; do not change all elevated panels

findings.title: Studio pagination count wraps outside its fixed-height badge
findings.environment: isolated local published QA; synthetic retained catalogue, no product edits
findings.actual: 1 / 6 wraps to three lines and extends outside the 32px count badge
findings.expected: Legible one-line page count and usable adjacent navigation
findings.reproduction: Open catalogue with more than 20 records and inspect list footer at 390 or 1440
findings.recommendedFix: Nonshrinking no-wrap count and flexible adjacent controls; retain page state and button semantics
findings.validation: 320/390/768/1440 layouts, multi-digit page count, keyboard Previous/Next and last-page state

referenceCapture.limits: No interaction certification; local and production content differ; preloader and settled Era states distinguished

broadLayoutReview.limits: Selected representative screenshots only; not all 588 screenshots manually inspected. Reduced full-page overviews support composition assessment, not fine text contrast or interaction certification.
